Plugin.Name: XikeStor LCD
Plugin.Overview: Drives the front-panel LCD on XikeStor NAS units, which otherwise stays on "STARTING SYSTEM" under Unraid. Shows CPU/system/disk temperatures, array capacity and network details (never waking spun-down disks), and lets the panel menu cleanly shut down or reboot the server. Configure under Settings - Utilities - XikeStor LCD.
Plugin.Requires: A XikeStor NAS with the front-panel LCD (USB device 374a:b101, "HOLTEK USB-HID AP"). No other dependencies.
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: xikestor lcd front panel display holtek nas screen
